meta.what: Log of the tracker's AI-agent runs: when, how many agents, what they were asked, which inputs they saw and what became of the result. Each firing of the agents is one row.

runs.label: Monthly nowcast of the partner figure with a two-component split
runs.question: Estimate the flag-basis partner-reported tuna figure for June to November 2026 and split it into a balance-of-payments component and a remainder.
runs.status: superseded for the split; the flag-basis total is still shown as the early estimate

runs.label: Bridge from the raw partner figure to true exports, 2025, without official figures
runs.question: Walk from the 2025 partner-reported tuna figure to an estimate of true exports in six layers.
runs.status: superseded by bridge-v2 (same question, official figures added to the evidence, three years)
runs.output: internal only; mean estimate for 2025 was USD 36.4 m (agents' 10th to 90th percentile 28.1 to 45.7)

runs.label: Bridge from the raw partner figure to true exports, 2023 to 2025, with official figures in the evidence
runs.question: Walk from each year's partner-reported tuna figure to an estimate of true exports in six layers, reading Kiribati's official statistics as evidence of what the compiler recorded.
